notes.title: Campaign to Finish!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, big news! Not only will we be releasing "Bloom: The Forest Burns" in early April, we'll ALSO be launching a campaign to try and pull in a bit of extra support to get this game finished right! 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/studiofawn/bloom-memories-a-group-effort]Follow along (click here) on KS to get an alert when we go live, and it will be a great chance to not only help bring this game to life....but also get a pretty nice discount for the help![/url]

With your support we can get the resources we need to really finish this game right.
